root_correction.finding: src/document/document_model.c initializes document_model_result result = {0}; the source-over-default-input-limit branch sets only error and parse_diagnostic.category, so parse_diagnostic.offset stays zero.
root_correction.rust_change: The source-limit diagnostic offset is now 0, and the corresponding new Rust assertion expects 0.
root_correction.large_file_editable_api: Later feature gap; outside this scope and not used to weaken the 16 MiB cap.

accepted_xml_contract.behavior: Collecting token Vec retained capacity is bounded by the byte limit; output exhaustion retains XmlError::OutputExhausted and its source offset. The document parser checks exposed capacities while stepping and after completion.

ownership_and_limits.source: DocumentModel<'source> borrows immutable original bytes and retains raw XmlSpan ranges; no decoded/reformatted source copies.
ownership_and_limits.node_table: Owned Vec<Node>, fallibly pre-reserved with checked count*size; at most 1,000,000 element nodes.
ownership_and_limits.attribute_table: Owned Vec<Attribute>, fallibly pre-reserved with checked count*size; XML total-attribute cap retained.
ownership_and_limits.errors: DocumentParseError carries DocumentError plus the exact XmlDiagnostic category and offset.
ownership_and_limits.allocation: try_reserve_exact for significant tables and bounded stack; no unsafe or dependencies.

c_symbols.rust: automatic DocumentModel drop; source lifetime enforced by Rust
types::allocate_document_id uses AtomicU64::try_update and rejects 0/MAX before allocation
parse::build_tables validates spans, consumes element/attribute tokens and builds bounded tables
DocumentModel::resolve checks document ID, slot, live bit and generation

api_adaptations: Rust query methods return Option or counts instead of C bool/out-parameters.
Document destruction is automatic and the borrow checker enforces source lifetime.
Invalid pointer/length arguments cannot be represented by a Rust slice; DocumentError::InvalidArgument and its stable name remain mapped, but safe parse_document has no invalid-slice case.
The deterministic ID seam is cfg(test)-only and shares the production next-ID transition; it cannot set or reset the global atomic.
downstream: Source editing/history and integration remain downstream work.
